title: Lambdas, sections & composition
hints: README 'New syntax': sections, lambdas, `map` and `.`. Every answer here is point-free: no parameter before `=`, just a function built from pieces (applyAll keeps its `fs`).

doubleAll / incrementAll: `map` with a section or a lambda. shout: uppercase every char, then append "!" (two functions joined with `.`). lengthsOfWords: split into words, then map length. applyAll: glue every function in the list together with `.`.
Other data: `negateAll = map negate` · `map (\x -> x * 10) [1, 2]` → [10,20] · `shrink = (/ 2) . abs` · `foldr (+) 0 [1, 2, 3]` → 6.
`shout = (++ "!") . map toUpper` · `lengthsOfWords = map length . words` · `applyAll fs = foldr (.) id fs` (id is the do-nothing function, the answer for an empty list).
